rtt_step_pattern.observation: RTTs in this CONTROL run fall on levels about 20 ms apart: {'26 ms': 76, '46 ms': 79, '66 ms': 83, '86 ms': 84, '106 ms': 82, '126 ms': 7, '146 ms': 3, '406 ms': 1} (counts of the 415 selected values by nearest level). The P95 of 105.994 ms is on the 106 ms level. The same pattern is present in the 8 other runs with 415 selected values: concentration R 0.865 to 0.998, share within 3 ms of the ladder 0.916 to 1.000; this run has R 0.916 and share 0.945.
rtt_step_pattern.measure: Circular concentration of RTT modulo 20 ms (R: 0 = even, 1 = all on one phase) and the share of values within 3 ms of the phase centre (a flat spread would give about 0.30).
rtt_step_pattern.status: Observation only. The cause is not established; an earlier working suspicion is system timing granularity. It is kept as a flag so the thesis analysis does not read the steps as network effects.
